views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates said Twilio’s share price rose 253% during Covid and then fell 83% afterwards, while noting its service was not specifically Covid related.

episode.title: COVID stocks that haven't recovered (yet?), Pimp my portfolio & should I invest in gold?

views.text: In June 2023, a guest on Equity Mates compared valuations, saying Twilio traded around two times sales, while Nvidia was at 25 times sales and Tesla at six, framing relative expectations in prices.

views.text: In November 2021, Equity Mates reported Twilio was down over 40% from its all-time high in late 2021, showing how pricing for many growth names had already turned.
